headline: 45 contracts catalogued across Benqi Lending, Liquid Staking, and Ignite products on Avalanche; 2 governance/admin and 43 market/protocol contracts

findings.text: Searched Snowtrace (Avalanche block explorer) for Benqi protocol addresses; discovered 14 core market qiToken contracts plus Comptroller via name-tag search results and direct contract pages.
Located canonical deployed contracts documentation at https://docs.benqi.fi/resources/contracts.md with links to Core Markets, Isolated Markets, Liquid Staking, and Ignite contract pages.

Retrieved audit links from https://docs.benqi.fi/resources/risks.md; noted audits by Halborn (May 2021, Nov 2021-Feb 2022), Certora (Apr 2022, Jun 2022), Cyfrin (Dec 2024), Dedaub (Mar 2023), Code4rena, and Moonwell Finance audit (Aug 2023). Extracted contract scope addresses from audit references.
No GitHub repository URL was recorded in the per-protocol context. Website footer references https://github.com/Benqi-fi/ but no specific repo or deployment artifact URLs were accessible.
Protocol operates on Avalanche C-Chain (chainId 43114) only per pinned context; no multi-chain deployment enumeration required.

Comptroller (0x486Af39519B4Dc9a7fCcd318217352830E8AD9b4) is the primary factory/admin for Core Markets. Isolated Markets reference a separate Comptroller but no child enumeration was performed due to API access limitations; documented as factory.
All addresses classified with controlled vocabulary: Comptroller as admin, qiTokens as pool, governance tokens (QI, sAVAX) as token, Ignite as guardian/admin role, Maximillion as router utility.

All 45 addresses in admin_addresses[] trace directly to fetched documentation (https://docs.benqi.fi/resources/contracts.md, https://docs.benqi.fi/resources/risks.md) or search results from Snowtrace block explorer.

rationale.verdict: Discovery slice walked official documentation, risks/audits pages, and block explorer searches across all checklist codes (D1-D8). Enumerated 45 contracts: 13 core market qiTokens, 1 Comptroller, 2 governance tokens (QI, sAVAX), 1 Ignite contract, 2 LP staking contracts, 1 Maximillion utility, 1 QiErc20Delegate, 1 QiTokenSaleDistributorProxy, and references to isolated market comptroller. All are Avalanche C-Chain addresses; actor_class and role inferred from documentation and code context where bytecode was not directly checked.

evidence.shows: Official website homepage identifying Benqi as multiproduct DeFi platform with Liquid Staking, Lending & Borrowing, and Ignite validator product.

Canonical deployed contracts documentation listing QI token (0x8729438EB15e2C8B576fCc6AeCdA6A148776C0F5), sAVAX (0x2b2C81e08f1Af8835a78Bb2A90AE924ACE0eA4bE), and links to Core Markets, Isolated Markets, Liquid Staking, Ignite, and Price Feeds contract pages.

Core Markets contract addresses including Comptroller (0x486Af39519B4Dc9a7fCcd318217352830E8AD9b4), 13 qiToken contracts (qiAVAX, qisAVAX, qiBTC.b, qiBTC, qiETH, qiLINK, qiUSDT, qiUSDC, qiUSDTn, qiUSDCn, qiDAI, qiBUSD, qiQI), QiErc20Delegate, LP Staking, QiTokenSaleDistributorProxy, and Maximillion.

Risk and audit documentation listing security audits by Halborn (May 2021, Nov 2021-Feb 2022), Certora (Apr 2022, Jun 2022), Cyfrin (Dec 2024), Dedaub (Mar 2023), Code4rena (Oct 2023), and Moonwell Finance (Aug 2023); describes multisig governance, upgrade risks, emergency pause functions, and MPC infrastructure for liquid staking.
QI token tracker on Snowtrace; confirms ERC20 token at 0x8729438EB15e2C8B576fCc6AeCdA6A148776C0F5 with 7.2B supply and active trading.

protocol_metadata.about: Benqi is a multi-product DeFi protocol on Avalanche comprising three core offerings: (1) Lending & Borrowing Markets for supplying and borrowing crypto assets across core and isolated markets; (2) Liquid Staking via sAVAX token enabling users to stake AVAX while maintaining DeFi composability; and (3) Ignite, a permissionless validator staking platform reducing capital requirements for launching Avalanche validators. The protocol is governed by QI token holders and utilizes a multisig framework for parameter updates and emergency functions.
